title: stc project (edit document), v4
description: Everything the user can change after recording. render(project, session, t) is a pure function of this document plus the session data. Adds PiP geometry in phase 3, and in v3 the transform version the edit was authored against (STC-308). v4 adds `zoom`: auto-zoom's user SETTINGS only — on/off, intensity and which easing preset. The windows themselves are DERIVED from events (transform/src/zoom.ts) and are never stored here, which is what lets a re-take regenerate them while keeping whatever the user chose.

fps.description: export samples every other 120 Hz sim tick; only 60 supported in phase 1

style.description: default is the macOS pointer set (STC-239); circle is the phase-1 placeholder, kept as an option

pip.description: Fixed-corner picture-in-picture. Absent means no PiP.

widthPct.description: fraction of output width; 0.125 gives 480px on a 3840px canvas

trim.description: Non-destructive in/out. Absent means the full take. Session-relative integer ns; endNs must be greater than startNs.

transform.description: Which transform renders this edit. TRANSFORM_HISTORY in transform/src/transform-version.ts says what each number drew; a change to any constant that reaches the pixels bumps it.

zoom.description: Auto-zoom settings (STC-325). Absent on every document written before project-4; parseProject fills the default.

intensity.description: Scales the eased amount. 1 is the preset's full travel; 0 is indistinguishable from off.

preset.description: Must equal ZOOM_PRESET_NAMES in transform/src/zoom.ts — a test holds the two together.
